description: Return full-detail frames from a session created by analyze_video, as images. Select them by frame number (as listed in REPORT.md) or by a time range. Use this after reading the report instead of opening every frame: each frame costs roughly 1.5k vision tokens.

from.description: Start of a time range, as SS.s / MM:SS.s.

indices.description: Frame numbers from the report timeline, e.g. [3, 4].

max_images.description: How many images to return at most. Default 4, ceiling 8.

session.description: The out_dir reported by analyze_video (the folder holding manifest.json).

name: get_frames
title: Read specific frames from an analysed video
